label: Healthy
note: Baseline motion: running parts rotate together. Illustrative simulation.

label: Shaft seal leak
note: Leakage at the shaft seal: motion unchanged, fluid lost. Illustrative.

label: Worn impeller
note: Worn impeller or ring clearances: head and flow fall. Illustrative.

label: Clogged passage
note: Clogged impeller or diffuser passage: flow starved. Illustrative.

label: Coupling misset
note: Improper coupling setting: tight rotation and rub. Illustrative.
